source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The root module declares its inputs in variables.tf, creates the topic and subscriptions in main.tf and then exposes the outputs in outputs.tf. The examples folders call this module for each type of subscription, and test/integration validates them on a project prepared by test/setup.
